source.paper: Reall, Tanahashi and Way, Causality and hyperbolicity of Lovelock theories, CQG 31 (2014) 205005

conventions.geometry: static, spherical, asymptotically flat Einstein-branch Boulware-Deser

classification.subcritical: 0<=lambda<sqrt(2)-1: all effective characteristic metrics are Lorentzian throughout the open static exterior
classification.threshold: lambda=sqrt(2)-1: scalar characteristic metric reaches degeneracy in the horizon limit; it is positive for rho>1
classification.supercritical: lambda>sqrt(2)-1: scalar characteristic metric is non-Lorentzian for 1<rho<rho_c

claim_ceiling: Exact static spherical characteristic-sector specialization only. It establishes the scalar effective-metric signature change for the static 5D BD branch. It does not establish strong hyperbolicity of a chosen gauge-fixed evolution formulation, rotating-background characteristics, mode stability, EFT validity, or nonlinear branch behavior.
